import { ArrowUpRight } from "lucide-react"; import { Link } from "react-router-dom"; const PROF_WORK = "PROFESSIONAL WORK" as const; const INDEP_PROJECT = "INDEPENDENT PROJECT" as const; interface FlagshipProject { number: string; title: string; category: string; classification: typeof PROF_WORK | typeof INDEP_PROJECT; role: string; problem: string; image: string; link: string; tags: string[]; } const flagshipProjects: FlagshipProject[] = [ { number: "01", title: "Volvo Partner Connect 2.0", category: "Enterprise SaaS / B2B Product Design", classification: PROF_WORK, role: "Lead UX/UI & Product Designer", problem: "Dealer managers were tracking key metrics across messy spreadsheets and disconnected tools. As the sole designer, I worked with stakeholders to map business requirements, built wireframes, and designed clean dashboards and charts for PDP, dealer investments, and branch performance.", image: "/volvo-partner.svg", link: "/volvo", tags: ["PDP Workflows", "Dealer Investment", "Scorecards", "DFHM Analytics"] }, { number: "02", title: "Fire Detection Live App", category: "AI Product / Industrial UX", classification: PROF_WORK, role: "UX/UI & Product Designer", problem: "Plant safety operators were getting overwhelmed by endless alarm lists without knowing where the actual danger was. I researched their daily workflow and designed a 2D floor map so operators can instantly locate incidents, view camera feeds, and dispatch help in seconds.", image: "/Fire.png", link: "/fire", tags: ["Spatial Floor Plan", "Thermal Camera Feeds", "Confidence Scores", "Quick Dispatch"] }, { number: "03", title: "3D Vehicle Configurator & Real-Time X-Ray Diagnostics", category: "Interactive 3D / Web Experience & Frontend", classification: PROF_WORK, role: "Product Designer & Frontend Developer", problem: "Heavy CAD files were freezing browsers during client presentations. I sat with the PM to understand the problem, designed the interface, and coded the WebGL frontend with an instant X-ray mode to inspect engines and cooling systems without lag.", image: "/car-3d.jpg", link: "/car-3d", tags: ["WebGL 3D Experience", "Dual-Mode Shaders", "Component Hotspots", "Frontend Code"] }, { number: "04", title: "EduHire", category: "AI-Powered E-Learning / Mobile Product Design", classification: INDEP_PROJECT, role: "End-to-End Product Designer", problem: "Most hiring platforms just match resumes to job posts without checking practical skills. I designed an interactive mobile app where job seekers practice realistic interview scenarios with an AI guide and get step-by-step learning paths to fix their weak spots.", image: "/Edu.png", link: "/eduhire", tags: ["AI Chat Guidance", "Skill Assessments", "Mobile Design", "Learning Paths"] }, { number: "05", title: "Audire", category: "AI Text-to-Speech / Mobile Product Design", classification: INDEP_PROJECT, role: "Lead Product Designer & UX Architect", problem: "Adjusting synthetic voice tone and pacing usually requires typing confusing code tags. I designed a mobile audio studio with simple timelines and sliders so creators can tweak pitch, speed, and emotion sentence by sentence.", image: "/Text.png", link: "/audire", tags: ["Prosody Timeline", "Waveform View", "Voice Personas", "Mobile Studio"] } ]; export default function SelectedWork() { return (
